body:
Klonopin
Took one, about 20 minutes later, started feeling pleasently dizzy. Not a bad dizzy at all, I was totally in control.  Then it tapered off into a wonderfull sense of calm.  I have anxiety issues, and this feels fricking great.  I'm going to ask my doctor if i can use this instead of ssri's,  SCREW SSRI's, I've gone through to many cold turkey withdrawls, and had my emotions sucked into a bag of numbness by those things.  This stuff has got my attention.  I had a date, I was nervous, I took one, everything went awesome, I could relax, for the first time ever.
